picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced 15-university, 10-state consortium to build and share leadership-class AI computing is a rare federal-academic mobilization at national scale, signaling AI infrastructure is becoming a coordinated public priority rather than a per-campus effort.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, built with UIUC and opened to researchers nationwide, meaningfully expands the national AI research computing base beyond elite labs.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: Up to $250 billion in planned investment—including a SpaceX spaceport and Meta's $50B+ data center buildout—tied to university and industry collaboration marks a massive, real-world bet on AI-driven infrastructure.
picks.title: Large tech firms, small startups and universities are fueling Louisiana’s bid to become the energy hub of tomorrow

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to advance light-based sensing and imaging science shows deep, sustained defense investment in AI-adjacent fundamental research.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: ASU's Intel-backed AI Research Acceleration Platform democratizes supercomputing access for its entire student and researcher population, a notable model for broadening who can do AI-scale research.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: AURORA, a robot-controlled AI cloud lab funded by a $20M NSF project, represents a genuine methodological advance in accelerating materials discovery through autonomous experimentation.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5 million, three-year commitment to Georgia Tech for AI-for-science tools and compute access reflects growing industry philanthropy aimed at broadening scientific AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: NJIT spinout OppyAI's 'Neural Crypto' hybrid-AI privacy technology moving to global commercialization is a concrete example of university research translating into market-ready AI products.
picks.title: NJIT Spinout OppyAI Takes Private Hybrid AI to the Global Stage

picks.editorial_note: The UK AI minister's announcement of new government measures to guard against AI risks, delivered at Imperial College London, signals concrete regulatory momentum rather than just rhetoric on AI safety.
picks.title: AI minister announces measures to protect against AI risks in speech at Imperial

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work probing LLM internals for warning signs of unsafe or misaligned behavior, motivated by a real 2026 incident, addresses one of the most consequential open problems in AI safety research.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs
